title_zh: 重返骑行先参加短程休闲组

scenario.label_zh: 商定重返骑行的非竞赛体验
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清俱乐部有休闲路线，并约定先参加一次短程活动和在起点会合

context_zh: 阿伦多年后想恢复骑行，向朋友贝丝询问俱乐部是否只有竞赛活动。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Does your club only do racing? I would like to ride again, but not against a clock.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: No. Our Sunday group stops for coffee and waits for everyone at each turn.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: I used to cycle regularly. Now I rarely get the bike out, so I am worried I will slow you down.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Come for the short route first. There is no prize for finishing before anyone else.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: I would be proud of myself just for getting back on the bike. How far is the short route?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Five miles, with a stop halfway. You can try it once without joining the club.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: That sounds manageable. I will meet the short-route group this Sunday.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Great. I will wait with you at the start and introduce you to the ride leader.
